name: Candida Colosimo
bioAdditions: Giovanna Candida was baptized on 2 February 1715, daughter of Giovanni Antonio Colosimo and Fenice Rizulo (S1). She married Gaetano Ferlaino in 1743 (S2). Her mother, Fenice Rizulo, is new to the tree.
